about: Hey Diya wake word rules, tuned with ci/wake_test.py. Step 1 'grammar': what the fast detector listens for (the offline model hears Diya as dear/deer/dia). Step 2: the last seconds are re-decoded with full vocabulary; Diya wakes only if that text matches 'confirm' and not 'block'. The last 'confirm' part allows one-breath commands (Hey Diya what's the time).
